sessions.title: A Make
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm động từ với 'make' liên quan đến việc tạo ra hoặc sản xuất một cái gì đó.
sessions.value:
# Everyday verbs 1

This unit deals with **make** and **do**, two verbs that many learners have problems with. If you remember that the basic meaning of **make** is about producing something and the basic meaning of **do** is about performing an action, then the collocations on this page may seem more logical.

## A Make

| collocation | example |
| --- | --- |
| make arrangements for | The school can **make arrangements for** pupils with special needs. |
| make a change / changes | The new manager is planning to **make some changes**. |
| make a choice | Amelia had to **make a choice** between her career and her family. |
| make a comment / comments | Would anyone like to **make any comments** on the talk? |
| make a contribution to | She **made a useful contribution to** the discussion. |
| make a decision | I’m glad it’s you who has to **make the decision**, not me. |
| make an effort | Michael is really **making an effort** with his maths this term. |
| make an excuse | I’m too tired to go out tonight. Let’s **make an excuse** and stay at home. |
| make friends | Caroline is very good at **making friends**. |
| make an improvement | Repainting the room has really **made an improvement**. |
| make a mistake | They’ve **made a mistake** in our bill. |
| make a phone call | I’ve got to **make some phone calls** before dinner. |
| make progress | Holly is **making progress** with all her schoolwork. |

sessions.title: B Do
sessions.description_vi: Các cụm động từ với 'do' liên quan đến việc thực hiện một hành động hoặc nhiệm vụ.
sessions.value:
# Everyday verbs 1

This unit deals with **make** and **do**, two verbs that many learners have problems with. If you remember that the basic meaning of **make** is about producing something and the basic meaning of **do** is about performing an action, then the collocations on this page may seem more logical.

## B Do

| collocation | example |
| --- | --- |
| do your best | All that matters in the exam is to **do your best**. |
| do damage | The storm **did some damage** to our roof. |
| do an experiment | We are **doing an experiment** to test how the metal reacts with water. |
| do exercises | We’ll **do some exercises** practising these collocations tomorrow. |
| do someone a good turn / do someone a favour | Could you **do me a favour** and pick me up some milk from the supermarket? Jess **did me a good turn** by lending me her car while mine was in the garage. |
| do harm | Changing the rules may **do more harm** than good. |
| do your hair | No, I’m not ready. I haven’t **done my hair** yet. |
| do your homework | My son has to **do his homework** straight after school. |
| do the ironing/shopping/washing, etc. | I’ll **do the washing** if you **do the ironing**. |
| do some work | We’ll **do some work** on our project and then we’ll go to the cinema. |

# Everyday verbs 1

This unit deals with **make** and **do**, two verbs that many learners have problems with. If you remember that the basic meaning of **make** is about producing something and the basic meaning of **do** is about performing an action, then the collocations on this page may seem more logical.

**Tip:** Notice all the patterns that you can see in these tables. For example, **make a comment**, **make an excuse** and **make a contribution to a discussion** are all connected with saying things. Noticing connections like this may help you to remember the correct collocation.

senses.definition_vi: Chuẩn bị hoặc sắp xếp mọi thứ cần thiết cho một sự kiện hoặc một người.
examples: The school can make arrangements for pupils with special needs.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng để chỉ việc chuẩn bị các dịch vụ hoặc hỗ trợ.

use_prompts.question: What do people need to prepare before travelling abroad?
How do families prepare for a wedding?
What should companies do before an important conference?

dictation.text: We need to make arrangements for the wedding.

paraphrase.source: I need to organise everything for my trip to Japan.
paraphrase.model: I need to make arrangements for my trip to Japan.

paraphrase.source: The school is preparing everything for the visitors next week.
paraphrase.model: The school is making arrangements for the visitors next week.

senses.definition_vi: Thực hiện một sự thay đổi hoặc một loạt các thay đổi.
examples: The new manager is planning to make some changes.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động thay đổi một cái gì đó.

use_prompts.question: What can people do to live a healthier life?
What should a company do if its staff are unhappy?
How can individuals help protect the planet?

dictation.text: I want to make a change in my daily routine.

paraphrase.source: If you want to be healthier, you should alter your diet.
paraphrase.model: If you want to be healthier, you should make changes to your diet.

paraphrase.source: The new manager wants to improve how the office works.
paraphrase.model: The new manager wants to make changes to how the office works.

senses.definition_vi: Quyết định chọn một cái gì đó từ nhiều lựa chọn.
examples: Amelia had to make a choice between her career and her family.
grammar_patterns: make a choice between A and B
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh hành động đưa ra quyết định lựa chọn.

use_prompts.question: How do people choose a holiday destination?
How do young people decide on a career?
How do people choose which phone to buy?

dictation.text: It is hard to make a choice when everything looks good.

paraphrase.source: Customers have to pick from hundreds of products.
paraphrase.model: Customers have to make a choice from hundreds of products.

paraphrase.source: I could not decide which dress to buy.
paraphrase.model: I could not make a choice about which dress to buy.

senses.definition_vi: Nói hoặc viết một ý kiến hoặc nhận xét về một chủ đề.
examples: Would anyone like to make any comments on the talk?
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong ngữ cảnh thảo luận hoặc đưa ra ý kiến.

use_prompts.question: Should people be allowed to write anything they like under online news articles?
How should staff give feedback on a manager's ideas?
Should students give feedback on their teachers?

dictation.text: Can I make a comment about your report?

paraphrase.source: Many people write their opinions under online news stories.
paraphrase.model: Many people make comments under online news stories.

paraphrase.source: The teacher wanted to say something about my essay.
paraphrase.model: The teacher wanted to make a comment about my essay.

senses.definition_vi: Đóng góp (tiền bạc, ý tưởng, công sức) vào một cái gì đó.
examples: She made a useful contribution to the discussion.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả việc đóng góp vào một mục tiêu chung hoặc một hoạt động.

use_prompts.question: How can ordinary people help their local community?
How can businesses help protect the environment?
What makes someone a valuable member of a team?

dictation.text: Everyone can make a contribution to the project.

paraphrase.source: Volunteers help the community in many ways.
paraphrase.model: Volunteers make a contribution to the community in many ways.

paraphrase.source: Immigrants give a lot to the economy.
paraphrase.model: Immigrants make an important contribution to the economy.

senses.definition_vi: Quyết định một điều gì đó.
examples: I’m glad it’s you who has to make the decision, not me.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh hành động đi đến một kết luận hoặc lựa chọn cuối cùng.

use_prompts.question: How do people decide where to go on holiday?
At what age are young people mature enough to decide important things?
Do people often buy expensive things without thinking carefully first?

dictation.text: It took her a week to make a decision.

paraphrase.source: Voters must decide who will lead the country.
paraphrase.model: Voters must make a decision about who will lead the country.

paraphrase.source: Do not rush; take time to decide.
paraphrase.model: Do not rush; take time to make a decision.

senses.definition_vi: Cố gắng hết sức để làm điều gì đó.
examples: Michael is really making an effort with his maths this term.
grammar_patterns: make an effort to do something
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả sự nỗ lực và cố gắng.

use_prompts.question: How can students improve their English quickly?
How can people keep in touch with old friends?
What can ordinary people do to reduce waste?

dictation.text: You should make an effort to speak English every day.

paraphrase.source: He tries hard to be polite to everyone.
paraphrase.model: He makes an effort to be polite to everyone.

paraphrase.source: We should try harder to recycle our rubbish.
paraphrase.model: We should make an effort to recycle our rubbish.

senses.definition_vi: Đưa ra một lý do để giải thích tại sao bạn không thể làm điều gì đó hoặc tại sao điều gì đó đã xảy ra.
examples: I’m too tired to go out tonight. Let’s make an excuse and stay at home.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường mang nghĩa tiêu cực, ám chỉ một lời bào chữa không hoàn toàn thật lòng.

use_prompts.question: Why do some employees often arrive late to work?
Why do some students not hand in their homework on time?
Why do many people avoid going to the gym?

dictation.text: He always makes an excuse to leave early.

paraphrase.source: Many people give a false reason for not exercising.
paraphrase.model: Many people make an excuse for not exercising.

paraphrase.source: She always invents a reason to avoid meetings.
paraphrase.model: She always makes an excuse to avoid meetings.

senses.definition_vi: Bắt đầu một tình bạn với ai đó.
examples: Caroline is very good at making friends.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động thiết lập mối quan hệ bạn bè.

use_prompts.question: How can international students meet new people at university?
Has social media made it easier to meet new people?
Is it important to get to know your colleagues personally?

dictation.text: It is easy to make friends at university.

paraphrase.source: Children who join sports clubs get to know other children easily.
paraphrase.model: Children who join sports clubs make friends easily.

paraphrase.source: Moving to a new city made it hard for me to meet people I could trust.
paraphrase.model: Moving to a new city made it hard for me to make friends.

senses.definition_vi: Cải thiện một cái gì đó.
examples: Repainting the room has really made an improvement.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động làm cho cái gì đó tốt hơn.

use_prompts.question: How can schools help weaker students?
How can hospitals improve their services?
What can cities do about poor air quality?

dictation.text: Small steps can make an improvement to your health.

paraphrase.source: The government needs to improve public transport.
paraphrase.model: The government needs to make an improvement to public transport.

paraphrase.source: Planting trees can improve the air in cities.
paraphrase.model: Planting trees can make an improvement to the air in cities.

senses.definition_vi: Phạm một lỗi sai.
examples: They’ve made a mistake in our bill.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động làm sai.

use_prompts.question: Should teachers correct students every time they get something wrong?
How should managers react when staff get something wrong?
What happens when doctors get a diagnosis wrong?

dictation.text: Everyone can make a mistake sometimes.

paraphrase.source: It is normal to get things wrong when learning a language.
paraphrase.model: It is normal to make mistakes when learning a language.

paraphrase.source: If you get something wrong at work, tell your boss.
paraphrase.model: If you make a mistake at work, tell your boss.

senses.definition_vi: Thực hiện một cuộc gọi điện thoại.
examples: I’ve got to make some phone calls before dinner.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động gọi điện thoại.

use_prompts.question: Do young people prefer texting to calling?
What is the first thing you do when you arrive in a new country?
How do people usually contact clients in your job?

dictation.text: I need to make a phone call before dinner.

paraphrase.source: Can I use your mobile to ring my mother?
paraphrase.model: Can I use your mobile to make a phone call to my mother?

paraphrase.source: Young people rarely ring anyone these days.
paraphrase.model: Young people rarely make phone calls these days.

senses.definition_vi: Tiến bộ, đạt được sự phát triển hoặc cải thiện.
examples: Holly is making progress with all her schoolwork.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả sự tiến triển theo hướng tích cực.

use_prompts.question: How can learners tell if their English is improving?
How do patients recover after a serious injury?
Are countries doing enough to fight climate change?

dictation.text: My son is making good progress at school.

paraphrase.source: Her English is getting better quickly.
paraphrase.model: She is making rapid progress in English.

paraphrase.source: Scientists are moving forward in the search for a cure.
paraphrase.model: Scientists are making progress in the search for a cure.

senses.definition_vi: Cố gắng hết sức mình.
examples: All that matters in the exam is to do your best.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Nhấn mạnh sự nỗ lực tối đa.

use_prompts.question: What advice would you give to students before an important exam?
Is winning more important than trying hard in sport?
What do employers expect from new staff?

dictation.text: Just do your best in the exam tomorrow.

paraphrase.source: Try as hard as you can in the interview.
paraphrase.model: Do your best in the interview.

paraphrase.source: Coaches tell children to try as hard as they can and not worry about winning.
paraphrase.model: Coaches tell children, 'Do your best and do not worry about winning.'

senses.definition_vi: Gây thiệt hại, phá hoại.
examples: The storm did some damage to our roof.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động gây tổn hại về vật chất hoặc tinh thần.

use_prompts.question: How do tourists harm natural areas?
How does smoking affect the body?
What problems do strong storms cause?

dictation.text: Strong winds can do damage to old buildings.

paraphrase.source: Floods can seriously harm homes and roads.
paraphrase.model: Floods can do serious damage to homes and roads.

paraphrase.source: Too much sun can harm your skin.
paraphrase.model: Too much sun can do damage to your skin.

senses.definition_vi: Thực hiện một thí nghiệm.
examples: We are doing an experiment to test how the metal reacts with water.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong ngữ cảnh khoa học hoặc học thuật.

use_prompts.question: How can science lessons be made more interesting?
How do companies test new products?
Should scientists test new medicines on animals?

dictation.text: Today we will do an experiment in the science lab.

paraphrase.source: The students will test how plants grow in the dark.
paraphrase.model: The students will do an experiment on how plants grow in the dark.

paraphrase.source: Scientists want to test the new drug on volunteers.
paraphrase.model: Scientists want to do an experiment with the new drug on volunteers.

senses.definition_vi: Thực hiện các bài tập.
examples: We’ll do some exercises practising these collocations tomorrow.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Thường dùng trong ngữ cảnh học tập hoặc rèn luyện thể chất.

use_prompts.question: What can office workers do to avoid back pain?
How do students practise grammar?
How do athletes warm up before a match?

dictation.text: I do exercises every morning before work.

paraphrase.source: My doctor told me to stretch my back every day.
paraphrase.model: My doctor told me to do exercises for my back every day.

paraphrase.source: The students practised the new grammar in their workbooks.
paraphrase.model: The students had to do exercises on the new grammar in their workbooks.

do_a_favour.word: do someone a good turn / do someone a favour

senses.definition_vi: Giúp đỡ ai đó một việc.
examples: Could you do me a favour and pick me up some milk from the supermarket?
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động giúp đỡ mang tính cá nhân.

use_prompts.question: How do neighbours help each other in your community?
Is it acceptable to ask colleagues for help with personal tasks?
Why do people help strangers?

dictation.target: do someone a good turn / do someone a favour
dictation.text: Could you do me a favour and close the window?

paraphrase.target: do someone a good turn / do someone a favour
paraphrase.source: Could you help me by carrying this bag?
paraphrase.model: Could you do me a favour and carry this bag?

paraphrase.target: do someone a good turn / do someone a favour
paraphrase.source: My neighbour kindly helped me by feeding my cat.
paraphrase.model: My neighbour did me a good turn by feeding my cat.

senses.definition_vi: Gây hại.
examples: Changing the rules may do more harm than good.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Đối lập với 'do good', diễn tả tác động tiêu cực.

use_prompts.question: Can taking too many vitamins be bad for you?
Are video games bad for children?
How do plastic bags affect sea life?

dictation.text: A little chocolate will not do you any harm.

paraphrase.source: Too much screen time can hurt children's eyes.
paraphrase.model: Too much screen time can do harm to children's eyes.

paraphrase.source: A short walk every day will never hurt you.
paraphrase.model: A short walk every day will never do you any harm.

senses.definition_vi: Chải hoặc tạo kiểu tóc.
examples: No, I’m not ready. I haven’t done my hair yet.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động chăm sóc hoặc tạo kiểu cho tóc.

use_prompts.question: How long do people spend getting ready for work?
How do people prepare for a wedding or a party?
Did your parents help you get ready for school as a child?

dictation.text: You should do your hair before the photos.

paraphrase.source: Can you brush and style your hair quickly before we go?
paraphrase.model: Can you do your hair quickly before we go?

paraphrase.source: If you style your own hair, you can save money.
paraphrase.model: If you do your own hair, you can save money.

senses.definition_vi: Làm bài tập về nhà.
examples: My son has to do his homework straight after school.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Một cụm từ rất phổ biến trong môi trường học đường.

use_prompts.question: Should children have homework every day?
Should children use the internet for their schoolwork?
Should parents help children with their schoolwork?

dictation.text: You must do your homework before watching TV.

paraphrase.source: You should finish your schoolwork before playing games.
paraphrase.model: You should do your homework before playing games.

paraphrase.source: Your teacher says you must finish your school exercises every evening.
paraphrase.model: Your teacher says you must do your homework every evening.

senses.definition_vi: Thực hiện các công việc nhà như là là quần áo, đi chợ, giặt giũ.
examples: I’ll do the washing if you do the ironing.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Dùng để chỉ các công việc lặp đi lặp lại trong gia đình.

use_prompts.question: How should couples share the housework?
Do working parents have time for household chores?
Are men doing more housework than in the past?

dictation.text: I will do the shopping if you do the ironing.

paraphrase.source: I usually buy the food for the week on Saturday.
paraphrase.model: I usually do the shopping on Saturday.

paraphrase.source: My husband washes the clothes, and I press them.
paraphrase.model: My husband does the washing, and I do the ironing.

senses.definition_vi: Thực hiện một công việc hoặc một phần công việc.
examples: We’ll do some work on our project and then we’ll go to the cinema.
senses.usage_notes_vi: Diễn tả hành động làm việc, thường là một phần hoặc một lượng nhất định.

use_prompts.question: Do you ever work at the weekend?
Where do you prefer to study, at home or in a library?
Can people work properly in cafés with free Wi-Fi?

dictation.text: I need to do some work this weekend.

paraphrase.source: I have to study a little tonight.
paraphrase.model: I have to do some work tonight.

paraphrase.source: Many people check emails and finish tasks on the train.
paraphrase.model: Many people do some work on the train.
